scope: Three supplied photos, three distinct verified test accounts; actual browser upload/backend queue/Mac worker verdicts and admin/user result UI. Existing validation criteria unchanged.
isolation: Fresh private SQLite beneath ignored data/, loopback API/Next, synthetic verified sessions, separate immutable test admin, random test-only worker credential and encrypted SSH reverse forwarding. No production accounts, trips, public posts or avatar assignments changed. Mac production worker/config unchanged.
